summary: Prove the complete read-only lab stack
description: Act as the independent promotion gate over all five real-service adapters, normalized inventory, doctor behavior, and deterministic fault scenarios before mutation planning begins.
acceptance: All five services appear in one schema-valid normalized inventory with service-level evidence and uncertainty.
The complete required scenario set yields exact expected doctor finding identifiers and severities with no blocker-level healthy-baseline false positives.
Unsupported versions and unreachable services produce typed blockers.
Credentials, runtime URLs, cookies, headers, private paths, and raw service responses never enter results, logs, or committed proof.
Read-only mode performs no domain mutation except the exact side-effect-free qBittorrent auth_session POST; all other POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE calls remain poisoned.
Independent review passes before task 10 becomes dependency-ready.
